builds.name: Stoneguard
builds.summary: Very tanky, strong frontline presence, most common. Strongest inside low-damage units.
builds.altSkill: Barricade can replace Shielded Charge (debuff + shield-break + cleanse) - not recommended: awkward animation, hard to aim, easy to interrupt, loses the mobility tool.

builds.name: Flameshackle
builds.summary: Most played. Farms ranged/rattan units, pops exotics, unbraces anticav (Stalwarts).
builds.altSkill: Shield Bash can replace Shield Charge or Kick (high damage + flames) - not recommended: no cleanse, long animation, easily interrupted, chain-CC bait; but fun and may work in some specific scenarios.

builds.name: Deathmatch Epic
builds.summary: Officer's Armour: no post-Ironsides debuff + it heals; duels light/medium heroes, wins long fights on sustain, very strong in small fights and on supply points. "It all depends on your playstyle and preference."
builds.altSkill: Shield Bash can replace Shield Charge or Kick (high damage + breaks shields) - not recommended: no cleanse, long animation, easily interrupted, chain-CC vulnerable; can still be useful in Deathmatch and fun vs low armor targets.

builds.name: Full Strength
builds.summary: More damage, way less tanky, leans on Ironsides and hero gameplay, needs good armor + weapon.

matchups.why: easy to chase and stagger with good damage burst.

matchups.vs: Zykalian, Sipho, rattans, other squishy ranged
matchups.why: increased flame damage - Flameshackle makes them explode.

matchups.vs: Low-damage melee units (Imperial Spearmen, Spear Sergeants)
matchups.why: Stoneguard thrives here - their hits feed the 15-hit heal.
SnS+Ironsides is the house's named answer - don't contest a DB-held supply point unless you are a Shortsword with Ironsides on. - house playbook
disrupt them, don't try to kill them - they wait out Ironsides before committing long cooldowns; bleed/poison/fire bypasses your defences.

matchups.vs: A tank SnS anchoring a Longsword (or PA)
matchups.why: SnS is the TANK anchor other classes pair with - LS pulls focus especially combined with a tank SnS or PA. - house playbook

matchups.vs: Damage-dealing units the hero enables while tanking
matchups.why: you count on your units and your team to win fights (low personal damage). [GAP: explicit own-warband unit pairings for SnS players - vets/house question]

techniques.name: Animation canceling
steps: Training room: try roll-canceling, dismount-canceling and blocking on every skill to learn which are cancelable.
techniques.rhythm: Amya: EVERY CLASS CAN DO IT! - Blocking is the primary cancel; roll canceling interrupts full spells, dismounts, and creates movement otherwise impossible. Costs extra stamina.

techniques.name: Active blocking
steps: it can be BROKEN and stagger you
techniques.rhythm: Don't get "Block checked" - Being an active blocker prevents undesired skills landing on you.

techniques.name: Horse-whistle CC immunity
steps: Time the whistle on the enemy CC
you take damage but no CC
techniques.rhythm: bugs out with PIN/LOCK skills, so care

techniques.name: Walk into braced units
steps: Walk (don't sprint) into their minimal range
techniques.rhythm: brace damage scales with your speed towards them - For braced units like Forte, Halberds, Phalanx - niche: enemy hero outnumbered, unaware or afk.

techniques.name: Auto-attack stagger
steps: Hold right-click whenever you see your shield moving up → instantly left-click → repeat.
techniques.rhythm: SanY: Important - Timed rhythm keeps enemy heroes interrupted and unable to react. Practice: hold right-click, left-click the moment the shield moves up, repeat. In duels add Sprint + auto-attack to chain staggers.

gameplay.text: Your role is to absorb damage, control fights, and prevent enemy heroes from playing effectively.
Take the lead in both attack and defense. Good mobility and protection.

roleLabel: Shortsword is a brawler class focused on tanking and disruption.

positioning.intro: Where to be during a fight:

bullets.text: Frontline, inside the fight - absorb damage, disrupt, make them waste effort killing you.
Inside low-damage enemy units on Stoneguard (Imperial Spearmen, Spear Sergeants) - the 15-hit set proc + Ironsides out-heals them.
Behind their line, in front of yours: Thunderstruck behind enemy units to knock them INTO your braced units.
Dive lanes on Flameshackle: high-value squishies behind enemy lines (exotics, Zykalian, Sipho, rattans); engage off the horse so the jump lands flames.
Supply points on the Epic build: sit on the point, refuse to die - Ironsides cleanse + heal makes you nearly impossible to shove off, and blocking the point stops unit pulls.
Stay near your team; on dives you can still get one-shot if careless.
Disruption and pressure over damage; create chaos, let units take the kills.

bullets.lead: Shielded Charge is the mobility tool -
bullets.text: engage, catch, or escape; don't burn it without a plan.

bullets.lead: Kick is the Swiss army knife:
bullets.text: cleanses stuns, breaks shields/block, raises defense (tier value), and on Flameshackle applies flames every hit.
pop it when focused or when trading on the Epic build.
On Flameshackle resist Full Strength: too much damage kills exotics before they explode and you lose the AoE payoff.
Play around cooldowns - a Shortsword with everything on cooldown is just a shield.
they wait out Ironsides before committing long cooldowns; bleed/poison/fire damage bypasses the defences.
even lighter-armored heroes can emergency-swap to a shortsword at supply to hold a flag a few seconds longer (wiki); a units-empty SnS still helps by blocking enemy supply points.

statSpreads.note: Full Strength = more damage but risky (squishier, can kill exotics before they explode)

combos.name: Flameshackle dive
combos.note: The jump applies flames on impact; use on exotics/squishy ranged (they take increased flame damage).

combos.name: Ironsides debuff bridge
steps: Kick right after (+40% defense 3s) or Thunderstruck (+20% defense 4s) to cover the window
combos.note: Covers the weakened-defences window after Ironsides. On the Officer's epic there is no window at all. (Wiki I lists -15%; guide value -20%)

combos.name: Stoneguard sustain loop
steps: stand inside low-damage enemy units (Imperial Spearmen, Spear Sergeants)
pop Ironsides while focused to heal back to full
combos.note: Their hits feed the 15-hit counter; Ironsides out-heals them.
